prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location review concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Geometry is a proposal, not certified collision or inventory. Exterior eaves hall on a coastal village garrison's OUTER street, entirely outside the guarded inner court. Plain handover table with two separate short wooden shift tally boards, a pair of rolled worn linen leg wraps resting on a stool. Broad dry ground-level passage returns to public village lane; separate unused covered doorway in background implies short-stay room but no bed visible. No weapons, military ceremony, patient carried away, healed injury, names list, forced recruitment or room key traded for labor. Focus separate work handover and civilian passage.
